name: qs
description: Captures every to-do, decision and question (q) a Claude session leaves for you into one list on your claude.ai account, and keeps it visible above the prompt.

artifactUrl.title: List page (leave empty to use /qs setup)
artifactUrl.description: Where your q's are kept: a private claude.ai page (https://claude.ai/artifact/...). Leave this empty and run /qs setup once to make one for you. Fill it in only to use a page you already have; every session using the same page shares one list.

sweep.title: Catch q's Claude forgot to file
sweep.description: On: after each longer reply, a small model (Haiku) rereads it and files anything left for you that Claude didn't add itself. Costs one small model call per reply. Off: only what Claude files.
